Discipline 01 &middot; Master Architecture

Landscape Design & Master Planning

Harmonizing residence architecture with topography, daylight, and botanical ecology.

Our comprehensive planning process analyzes site contours, solar exposure, stormwater runoff, and long-term tree canopies. We translate client lifestyle into layered 3D spatial models and precise material specifications before any earth is moved.

Core Inclusions:

  • Topographical survey & 3D digital landscape modeling
  • Native & climate-resilient botanical selections
  • Outdoor pedestrian circulation & zoning plans
  • Comprehensive hardscape & masonry blueprints
  • Low-voltage ambient illumination layouts

Discipline 02 &middot; Horticultural Renewal

Garden Design & Renovation

Restoring organic vitality to neglected, overcrowded, or aging Pacific Northwest grounds.

Whether revitalizing established perennial beds or executing a complete property renovation, our certified horticulturists remediate exhausted soil biomes, reconstruct dry-stacked stone retaining walls, and introduce layered four-season botanical textures.

Core Inclusions:

  • Soil biome testing & organic compost enrichment
  • Selective pruning, crown thinning & tree preservation
  • Tiered perennial borders with multi-season bloom schedules
  • Decorative fieldstone borders & weed suppression layers
  • Micro-climate shade and moisture zoning

Discipline 03 &middot; Turf Engineering

Lawn Installation & Turf Care

Enduring, weed-resistant emerald turf engineered from foundational grading upward.

A resilient lawn requires proper ground preparation. We laser-grade soil sub-bases to eliminate pooling, blend specialized organic amendments, and install certified regional sod varieties that resist foot traffic, pests, and summer droughts.

Core Inclusions:

  • Precision laser grading & slope runoff control
  • Exhausted turf removal & deep subterranean aeration
  • Certified regional drought-tolerant fescue & bluegrass sod
  • Integrated sub-surface drip & low-angle spray design
  • Seasonal biological fertilizing & thatch management

Discipline 04 &middot; Artisan Hardscapes

Outdoor Living Spaces & Patios

Extending interior refinement into sheltered, open-air living and dining terraces.

From hand-tooled natural bluestone terraces and contemporary thermal pavers to custom natural stone fire features and timber pergola structures, we construct outdoor gathering rooms built to endure Northwest rainfall and frosty winters.

Core Inclusions:

  • Thermal-finished bluestone, granite & permeable paver terraces
  • Custom gas fire tables, fire pits & outdoor stone fireplaces
  • Architectural cedar pergolas, privacy louvers & trellis screens
  • Integrated outdoor kitchen stations & stone bar counters
  • Concealed downspout drainage & frost-heave defense

Discipline 05 &middot; Living Architecture

Tree & Specimen Plant Installation

Structural canopy shade, blooming ornamental groves, and dense privacy hedges.

Trees and structural shrubs define the living framework of any landscape. We hand-select specimen trees directly from reputable regional growers, transporting and crane-planting them with comprehensive root-flare preservation and biological soil inoculation.

Core Inclusions:

  • Mature shade & ornamental specimen tree crane installation
  • Dense evergreen privacy screens (Arborvitae, Laurel, Yew)
  • Pollinator-supporting native understory shrub colonies
  • Deep-root biological feeding & structural guy-wire staking
  • Multi-year root establishment warranty & monitoring

Discipline 06 &middot; Commercial Presence

Commercial Landscaping & Corporate Grounds

Striking corporate campuses, retail entries, and sustainable property developments.

Create an unmistakable first impression for clients, tenants, and visitors. Evergreen Landscapes delivers high-impact street frontage, modern drought-tolerant gravel plazas, and low-maintenance green spaces with zero interruption to daily operations.

Core Inclusions:

  • Corporate campus master planning & construction
  • Executive entrance courtyards & seasonal rotation planters
  • Water-conserving xeriscape & permeable gravel circulation
  • Commercial maintenance specifications & irrigation auditing
  • ADA-compliant walkway grades & safety lighting

Discipline 07 &middot; Water Conservation

Irrigation & Subsurface Drainage Solutions

Safeguarding landscape longevity with smart hydrological management.

Excess water compromises foundations and plantings, while underwatering wastes valuable resources. We engineer weather-sensing smart drip arrays alongside hidden gravel French drains, catch basins, and bioswales that manage high Northwest precipitation naturally.

Core Inclusions:

  • Wi-Fi connected weather-sensing irrigation controllers
  • Targeted root-zone drip lines & pressure-regulated micro-emitters
  • Subsurface French drain systems & foundation waterproofing
  • Rain gardens, permeable swales & stormwater recharge
  • Spring backflow testing, activation & winterization blowouts
